name: TheChatPress.com
author: The Chat Press Team

sections.description:
TheChatPress.com brings an intelligent AI agent directly into your WordPress website, helping you:
– Provide instant answers to visitors’ questions.
– Streamline customer support and pre-sales conversations.
– Reduce manual workload with automated interactions.
– Easily customize and manage your AI agent from TheChatPress admin screen.

Key Features:
– One-Click Setup: Instantly generate unique identifiers (UUIDs) and inject the required code by clicking a single button.
– Automatic Script Injection: The plugin automatically inserts your custom snippet into the site’s body code.
– Simple Reset: Need to recreate or change your AI agent’s credentials? One click resets everything.
– Seamless Integration: No coding knowledge required. Activate the plugin, click “Generate and Inject Code,” and you’re done.

How It Works:
1. Automated Configuration: Upon clicking “Generate and Inject Code,” the plugin communicates with TheChatPress servers to save your agent’s configuration and produce the chat widget snippet.
2. Ready to Assist: The snippet is then placed automatically on every page, so visitors can start chatting right away.
3. Assistant Configuration: You can tune your assistant (eg. knowledge base, speech, color, and more) in the URL that is uniquely generated.

External Services

For the plugin’s functionality, it’s critical:
1. This plugin connects to TheChatPress external API to generate a unique configuration and retrieve the chat widget snippet for your site.
2. The plugin fetches and loads an external JavaScript file from TheChatPress servers to display the chat widget with the account configuration.

The external TheChatPress service does not receive any sensitive data from WordPress. The sole purpose of integrating with TheChatPress is to create the account, provide the widget code, and supply the API that the widget uses.

This plugin is designed to enable a seamless one-click installation for websites to access TheChatPress and, in the future, manage detailed configurations directly from WordPress rather than through TheChatPress.

Service Provider: TheChatPress
Purpose: To generate unique AI agent credentials and initial configuration.
Data Sent: Website URL, and randomly generated UUID to register the new account upon click by the user.
Privacy Policy: https://thechatpress.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://thechatpress.com/terms-of-service/

License

sections.installation:
1. Download the Plugin:
    • Download the ZIP file from the WordPress Plugin Directory or from your account on TheChatPress.com.
  2. Install via WordPress Admin:
    • Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin in your WordPress admin.
    • Upload the ZIP file, then click Install Now.
  3. Activate the Plugin:
    • Once installed, click Activate.
  4. Configure:
    • A new menu item “TheChatPress” will appear in your WordPress admin.
    • Click “Generate and Inject Code” to retrieve your unique credentials and script.
sections.faq:
1. How does TheChatPress AI Assistant benefit my website?

The AI Assistant answers your visitors’ questions in real time, providing instant customer support and saving you time. It can also capture leads, share product info, or direct users to specific resources based on their queries.

2. Do I need any coding skills to set this up?

Not at all! The plugin handles the initial assistant generation and script injection automatically. Just install, activate, and click the button.

3. What if I want to change my AI agent or start fresh?

Use the “Recreate / Reset UUIDs” button on the TheChatPress admin page to erase your existing configuration and generate new credentials.

4. Does it slow down my site?

The script is loaded asynchronously, ensuring minimal impact on page load times.

5. Where can I manage or customize the AI Assistant’s behavior?

Log into TheChatPress.com to configure advanced settings, such as conversation flows, knowledge base, or branding. The WordPress plugin simply fetches and injects the AI widget.

6. Is it free to use?

Some features may require a premium plan. Please check pricing details on TheChatPress.com.
